fanoutqa_004340.x:
World Marathon Majors :: Six star finishers :: chunk_0024
**Six star finishers** are marathoners who have completed six of the World Marathon Majors (without including Sydney). In 2016 following the [Tokyo Marathon](/wiki/Tokyo_Marathon "Tokyo Marathon") a Six Star Finisher Medal was introduced.[[30]](#cite_note-44) In July 2018 a "Reach for the Stars" campaign was launched wherein a runner could claim a star for each WMM race completed. The system allows runners to create a profile, search for their ‘stars’ and add them to their page.[[31]](#cite_note-45)

Following the TCS London Marathon in April, 2025, the verified total of Six Star Finishers was 22,480 from 139 total nations.

In 1931, without declaring war, [Japan invaded Manchuria](/wiki/Japanese_invasion_of_Manchuria "Japanese invasion of Manchuria"), seeking raw materials to fuel its growing industrial economy. By 1937, Japan controlled Manchuria and was prepared to move deeper into China. The [Nationalist Party](/wiki/Kuomintang "Kuomintang") and the [Chinese Communists](/wiki/Communist_Party_of_China "Communist Party of China") suspended [their civil war](/wiki/Chinese_civil_war "Chinese civil war") in order to form a [nominal alliance](/wiki/Second_United_Front "Second United Front") against Japan, and the Soviet Union quickly [lent support](/wiki/Sino-Soviet_Non-Aggression_Pact "Sino-Soviet Non-Aggression Pact") by providing large amounts of materiel to Chinese troops. Sahara :: History :: chunk_0011
[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/11/Mathendous_giraffes.jpg/250px-Mathendous_giraffes.jpg)](/wiki/File:Mathendous_giraffes.jpg)

[Saharan rock art](/wiki/Saharan_rock_art "Saharan rock art") in the [Fezzan](/wiki/Fezzan "Fezzan")

Scientists have identified more than 230 [humid periods](/wiki/African_humid_period "African humid period") in North Africa, occurring every 21,000 years for the past eight million years.[[59]](#cite_note-59)[[60]](#cite_note-60)[[61]](#cite_note-61)

A modern laboratory examination of the [Uan Muhuggiag](/wiki/Uan_Muhuggiag "Uan Muhuggiag") [child mummy](/wiki/Uan_Muhuggiag#Tashwinat_Mummy "Uan Muhuggiag") and Tin Hanakaten child have suggested that the Central Saharan peoples from the [Epipaleolithic](/wiki/Epipaleolithic "Epipaleolithic"), [Mesolithic](/wiki/Mesolithic "Mesolithic"), and [Pastoral](/wiki/Pastoral_Period "Pastoral Period") periods possessed dark skin complexions.[[62]](#cite_note-62) The creators of the [Round Head rock art](/wiki/Round_Head_rock_art "Round Head rock art") possessed [dark skin](/wiki/Dark_skin "Dark skin").[[63]](#cite_note-63)[[64]](#cite_note-64)

A 2025 study sequenced individuals from [Takarkori](/wiki/Takarkori "Takarkori") (7,000 YBP) and discovered that most of their ancestry was from an unknown ancestral North African lineage, related to the African admixture component found in [Iberomaurusians](/wiki/Iberomaurusian "Iberomaurusian").[[65]](#cite_note-65) According to the study, the Takarkori people were distinct from both contemporary sub-Saharan Africans and non-Africans/Eurasians. They had "only a minor component of non-African ancestry" but did "not carry sub-Saharan African ancestry, suggesting that, contrary to previous interpretations, the [Green Sahara](/wiki/Green_Sahara "Green Sahara") was not a corridor connecting Northern and sub-Saharan Africa."[[66]](#cite_note-66) As per [Johannes Krause](/wiki/Johannes_Krause "Johannes Krause")

Yao was pressured to enter the [NBA draft in 1999](/wiki/1999_NBA_draft "1999 NBA draft") by Li Yaomin, the deputy general manager of the Shanghai Sharks.[[16]](#cite_note-ref3-16) Li also influenced Yao to sign a contract for Evergreen Sports Inc. to serve as his agent. The agreement entitled Evergreen to 33% of Yao's earnings,[[16]](#cite_note-ref3-16) but the contract was later determined to be invalid.[[23]](#cite_note-23)

As American attention on Yao grew, Chinese authorities also took interest. In 2002, the Chinese government released new regulations that would require him and other Chinese players to turn over half of any NBA earnings to the government and China's national basketball association, including endorsements as well as salaries.[[24]](#cite_note-24)

When Yao decided to enter the [2002 NBA draft](/wiki/2002_NBA_draft "2002 NBA draft"), a group of advisers was formed that came to be known as "Team Yao". The team consisted of Yao's negotiator, Erik Zhang; his NBA agent, Bill Duffy; his Chinese agent, Lu Hao; [University of Chicago](/wiki/University_of_Chicago "University of Chicago") economics professor John Huizinga;[[25]](#cite_note-25) and the vice president for marketing at BDA Sports Management, Bill Sanders.[[26]](#cite_note-26) Yao was widely predicted to be picked number one overall.[[27]](#cite_note-27)[[28]](#cite_note-28)[[29]](#cite_note-29) However, some teams were concerned about Yao's NBA eligibility because of uncertainty over whether the CBA would let Yao play in the United States.[[30]](#cite_note-30)

At age 15, with his mother's and stepfather's help, John was hired as a pianist at a nearby pub, the Northwood Hills Hotel, playing Thursday to Sunday nights.[[35]](#cite_note-35)[[36]](#cite_note-36) Known simply as "Reggie", he played a range of popular standards, including songs by [Jim Reeves](/wiki/Jim_Reeves "Jim Reeves") and [Ray Charles](/wiki/Ray_Charles "Ray Charles"), as well as his own songs.[[37]](#cite_note-Costello_interview-37)[[38]](#cite_note-p70-38) A stint with a short-lived group called the Corvettes rounded out his time.[[29]](#cite_note-Rosenthal-29) Although normal-sighted as a teenager, John began wearing horn-rimmed glasses to imitate [Buddy Holly](/wiki/Buddy_Holly "Buddy Holly").[[39]](#cite_note-39)[[40]](#cite_note-40)

In 1962, John and some friends formed a band named [Bluesology](/wiki/Bluesology "Bluesology"). By day, he ran errands for a music publishing company; he divided his nights between solo gigs at a London hotel bar and working with Bluesology. By the mid-1960s, Bluesology were backing touring American [soul](/wiki/Soul_music "Soul music") and R&B musicians such as [the Isley Brothers](/wiki/The_Isley_Brothers "The Isley Brothers"), [Major Lance](/wiki/Major_Lance "Major Lance") and [Patti LaBelle and the Bluebelles](/wiki/Patti_LaBelle_and_the_Bluebelles "Patti LaBelle and the Bluebelles"). In 1966 the band became [Long John Baldry](/wiki/Long_John_Baldry "Long John Baldry")'s supporting band and played 16 times at the [Marquee Club](/wiki/Marquee_Club "Marquee Club").[[41]](#cite_note-41)

fanoutqa_002292.t: List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita :: Method :: chunk_0001
fanoutqa_002292.x:
List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita :: Method :: chunk_0001
The [gross domestic product](/wiki/Gross_domestic_product "Gross domestic product") (GDP) [per capita](/wiki/Per_capita "Per capita") figures on this page are derived from PPP calculations. Such calculations are prepared by various organizations, including the [IMF](/wiki/IMF "IMF") and the [World Bank](/wiki/World_Bank "World Bank"). As estimates and assumptions have to be made, the results produced by different organizations for the same country are not hard facts and tend to differ, sometimes substantially, so they should be used with caution.

Comparisons of national wealth are frequently made based on *nominal* GDP and [savings](/wiki/Savings "Savings") (not just income), which do not reflect differences in the [cost of living](/wiki/Cost_of_living "Cost of living") in different countries (*see [List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita](/wiki/List_of_countries_by_GDP_(nominal)_per_capita "List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita")*); hence, using a PPP basis is arguably more useful when comparing [generalized](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/generalized "wikt:generalized") differences in [living standards](/wiki/Living_standards "Living standards") between economies because PPP takes into account the relative cost of living and the [inflation rates](/wiki/Inflation_rates "Inflation rates") of the countries, rather than using only [exchange rates](/wiki/Exchange_rates "Exchange rates"), which may distort the real differences in income.

This is why GDP (PPP) per capita is considered one of the indicators of a country's standard of living,[[2]](#cite_note-3)[[3]](#cite_note-4) The relation between [GDP per capita and standard of living](/wiki/Gross_domestic_product#Standard_of_living "Gross domestic product") has been criticized. Alternative measures of standard of living include [list of countries by average wage](/wiki/List_of_countries_by_average_wage "List of countries by average wage"

Maria Cantwell :: Early life, education, and early political career :: chunk_0002
Cantwell was born in [Indianapolis](/wiki/Indianapolis "Indianapolis"), [Indiana](/wiki/Indiana "Indiana"). She was raised in a predominantly [Irish American](/wiki/Irish_Americans "Irish Americans") neighborhood on the south side of Indianapolis. Her father, [Paul Cantwell](/wiki/Paul_Cantwell "Paul Cantwell"),[[2]](#cite_note-fprgd-2) served as county commissioner, city councilor, state legislator, and chief of staff for U.S. Representative [Andrew Jacobs Jr.](/wiki/Andrew_Jacobs_Jr. "Andrew Jacobs Jr.")[[2]](#cite_note-fprgd-2) and was the Democratic nominee for mayor of Indianapolis [in 1979](/wiki/1979_Indianapolis_mayoral_election "1979 Indianapolis mayoral election").[[3]](#cite_note-3) Her mother, Rose, was an administrative assistant. Her ancestry includes Irish and German.[[2]](#cite_note-fprgd-2)

Cantwell attended [Emmerich Manual High School](/wiki/Emmerich_Manual_High_School "Emmerich Manual High School"), and was inducted into the [Indianapolis Public Schools](/wiki/Indianapolis_Public_Schools "Indianapolis Public Schools") Hall of Fame in 2006.[[4]](#cite_note-4) After high school, she attended [Miami University](/wiki/Miami_University "Miami University") in [Oxford, Ohio](/wiki/Oxford,_Ohio "Oxford, Ohio"), where she earned her [Bachelor of Arts](/wiki/Bachelor_of_Arts "Bachelor of Arts") degree in public administration.[[5]](#cite_note-:0-5)

A year after graduating, Cantwell worked on [Jerry Springer](/wiki/Jerry_Springer "Jerry Springer")'s unsuccessful [1982 Ohio gubernatorial campaign](/wiki/1982_Ohio_gubernatorial_election "1982 Ohio gubernatorial election").[[6]](#cite_note-Mundy1-6) In 1983, she moved to [Seattle](/wiki/Seattle "Seattle"), [Washington](/wiki/Washington_(state) "Washington (state)"), to campaign for U.S. Senator [Alan Cranston](/wiki/Alan_Cranston "Alan Cranston") in his unsuccessful bid for the [1984 Democratic presidential nomination](/wiki/De

**France**,[[h]](#cite_note-17) officially the **French Republic**,[[i]](#cite_note-18) is a country primarily located in [Western Europe](/wiki/Western_Europe "Western Europe").[[j]](#cite_note-19) [Its overseas regions and territories](/wiki/Overseas_France "Overseas France") include [French Guiana](/wiki/French_Guiana "French Guiana") in [South America](/wiki/South_America "South America"), [Saint Pierre and Miquelon](/wiki/Saint_Pierre_and_Miquelon "Saint Pierre and Miquelon") in the [North Atlantic](/wiki/North_Atlantic "North Atlantic"), the [French West Indies](/wiki/French_West_Indies "French West Indies"), and [many islands](/wiki/List_of_islands_of_France "List of islands of France") in [Oceania](/wiki/Oceania "Oceania") and the [Indian Ocean](/wiki/Indian_Ocean "Indian Ocean"). [Metropolitan France](/wiki/Metropolitan_France "Metropolitan France") shares borders with [Belgium](/wiki/Belgium "Belgium") and [Luxembourg](/wiki/Luxembourg "Luxembourg") to the north; [Germany](/wiki/Germany "Germany") to the northeast; [Switzerland](/wiki/Switzerland "Switzerland") to the east; [Italy](/wiki/Italy "Italy") and [Monaco](/wiki/Monaco "Monaco") to the southeast; [Andorra](/wiki/Andorra "Andorra") and [Spain](/wiki/Spain "Spain") to the south; and a maritime border with the [United Kingdom](/wiki/United_Kingdom "United Kingdom") to the northwest. Its metropolitan area extends from the [Rhine](/wiki/Rhine "Rhine") to the [Atlantic Ocean](/wiki/Atlantic_Ocean "Atlantic Ocean") and from the [Mediterranean Sea](/wiki/Mediterranean_Sea "Mediterranean Sea") to the [English Channel](/wiki/English_Channel "English Channel") and the [North Sea](/wiki/North_Sea "North Sea"). Its 18 [integral regions](/wiki/Regions_of_France "Regions of France")—five of which are overseas—span a combined area of 632,702 km2 (244,288 sq mi), with [a total population](/wiki/Demographics_of_France "Demographics of France") estimated at over 69.1 million in 2026.

fanoutqa_008692.x:
John F. Kennedy :: Presidency (1961–1963) :: Foreign policy :: Vienna Summit and the Berlin Wall :: chunk_0023
See also: [Vienna summit](/wiki/Vienna_summit "Vienna summit") and [Berlin Crisis of 1961](/wiki/Berlin_Crisis_of_1961 "Berlin Crisis of 1961")

Kennedy anxiously anticipated a summit with Nikita Khrushchev. The proceedings for the summit got off to a problematic start when Kennedy reacted aggressively to a routine Khrushchev speech on Cold War confrontation in early 1961. The speech was intended for domestic audiences in the Soviet Union, but Kennedy interpreted it as a personal challenge. His mistake helped raise tensions going into the [Vienna summit](/wiki/Vienna_summit "Vienna summit").[[188]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKempe201176–78-190) The summit would cover several topics, but both leaders knew that the most contentious issue would be [Berlin](/wiki/Berlin "Berlin"), which had been divided in two with the start of the Cold War. The enclave of [West Berlin](/wiki/West_Berlin "West Berlin") lay within Soviet-allied [East Germany](/wiki/East_Germany "East Germany"), but was supported by the U.S. and other Western powers. The Soviets wanted to reunify Berlin under the control of East Germany, partly due to the large number of East Germans who had fled to West Berlin.[[189]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrinkley201274,_77–78-191)

Cristiano Ronaldo :: Personal life :: Family, children, and relationships :: chunk_0033
Ronaldo is a [Catholic](/wiki/Catholic_Church "Catholic Church").[[412]](#cite_note-416) Within his ancestry, he is of (one-eighth) Cape Verdean descent through his great-grandmother.[[413]](#cite_note-417) Ronaldo's great-grandmother on his father's side, Isabel da Piedade, an African woman, was born in the island of [São Vicente](/wiki/S%C3%A3o_Vicente,_Cape_Verde "São Vicente, Cape Verde"), in what was then [Portuguese Cape Verde](/wiki/Portuguese_Cape_Verde "Portuguese Cape Verde"), and moved to the island of Madeira when she was 16.[[414]](#cite_note-418)[[415]](#cite_note-419)

His father, José, died of an alcoholism-related liver condition at age 52 in September 2005 when Ronaldo was 20.[[416]](#cite_note-420) After her son achieved legendary status in world football, Cristiano Ronaldo's mother, Dolores Aveiro, became a popular personality in Portugal to such an extent that advertising campaigns for well-known brands in the country, such as [Maggi](/wiki/Maggi "Maggi"), MultiOpticas and [Pingo Doce](/wiki/Pingo_Doce "Pingo Doce"), have featured her in commercials.[[417]](#cite_note-421)[[418]](#cite_note-422)

Ronaldo has five living children. He first became a father to a son, Cristiano Ronaldo Jr., who was born on 17 June 2010 in the United States.[[419]](#cite_note-423) He has full custody of the child and has not publicly revealed the identity of the mother per an agreement with her.[[420]](#cite_note-424)[[421]](#cite_note-425) Ronaldo Jr. is a youth footballer who plays for Portugal Under-15s.[[422]](#cite_note-426) In January 2015, Ronaldo's five-year relationship with Russian model [Irina Shayk](/wiki/Irina_Shayk "Irina Shayk") ended.[[423]](#cite_note-427) Then, in 2017, Ronaldo became a father to [twins](/wiki/Twin "Twin"),[[424]](#cite_note-428) born on 8 June 2017 in the United States via [surrogacy](/wiki/Surrogacy "Surrogacy").
